title: StockSmart Storeroom Backup for VendPoint Start-Up Items — Coordination Memo
content:
Where a machine of the VendPoint Industrial Vending Program stands at a ship-to that also runs a StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program, the storeroom bins of that program back up the item most recently added to the machine when Corbett re-sizes its par in the start-up par review.

**Rule.** The storeroom backup factor follows the StockSmart program whose status is active at the machine's ship-to: when that program carries a bin for the item, meaning its new-bin entries for the item outnumber its bin removal entries for the item, and the item's latest bin set entry on that program, new bin or par change, which is the one carrying the highest bin request reference since StockSmart issues those references in sequence, is flagged critical, the factor is the critical-bin backup factor; when that program carries a bin for the item and that latest bin set entry is not flagged critical, the factor is the plain-bin backup factor; otherwise the factor is one.

**Figures.** The critical-bin backup factor is 0.7 and the plain-bin backup factor is 0.85.

**Records read.** The StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program record at the machine's ship-to with status active, and that program's bin entries for the same item: its new-bin entries, its bin removal entries, and its bin set entries (new bin or par change) with their bin request references and critical flags.

| Active StockSmart program at the ship-to | New-bin entries outnumber removal entries for the item | Latest bin set entry flagged critical | Factor |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | 0.7 |
| Yes | Yes | No | 0.85 |
| Yes | No (equal or fewer) | either | 1 |
| No | not applicable | not applicable | 1 |

Hypothetical count: two new-bin entries and one removal entry for the item mean the program carries a bin; one new-bin entry and one removal entry mean it does not.
